about_short_description.short_description: Teamflow provides remote teams with a set of tools, facilitating collaborative meetings and problem-solving sessions.

product.name: Teamflow Virtual Office
product.description: A virtual office platform that enables remote teams to collaborate through spatial video chat, shared workspaces, and spontaneous interactions.

product.name: Virtual Sales Floor
product.description: A virtual sales bullpen integrated with dialers to enable real-time cold calling, live coaching, and team collaboration for sales development representatives.

product.name: Screen Sharing with Shared Pointers
product.description: A screen sharing tool that allows multiple simultaneous screen shares with shared pointers and real-time reactions for collaborative remote work.

product.name: Shared Browser
product.description: A multiplayer shared web browser that allows team members to co-browse websites together in real-time within the virtual office environment.

product.name: Private Rooms
product.description: Virtual private meeting rooms within Teamflow that restrict access to selected participants for focused discussions or 1:1 meetings.
